header_desc: Customize dock, monitored hardware and bar style
language_desc: Select the display language for the application
dock_desc: Monitor edge where the panel docks
monitor_desc: Choose which screen displays the diagnostic sidebar
appbar_desc: Pushes maximized windows so they do not overlap the sidebar
always_top_desc: Keep sidebar visible above normal windows
startup_desc: Run ZenithBar automatically when computer boots
initially_hidden_desc: Starts minimized directly to system tray
tray_icon_desc: Shows icon next to Windows clock with quick menu
click_through_desc: Allows clicking through the bar to items behind it
collapse_menu_desc: Hides settings and dock buttons for minimal look
auto_update_desc: Periodically checks for new ZenithBar versions
sidebar_width_desc: Custom width from 180px to 360px reserved on screen
bg_opacity_desc: Intensity of Fluent translucent glass effect
text_align_desc: Orientation of texts and metrics in cards
show_hostname_desc: Shows machine name in top card
show_clock_desc: Shows time and date at top of sidebar
alert_blink_desc: Highlights in red when temp > 80°C and load > 85%
show_cores_desc: Displays micro-bar for each physical/logical core
enable_ram_desc: Used GB, system total and percent occupied
enable_gpu_desc: 3D load, GPU temperature, VRAM and fan RPM
enable_disks_desc: Disk space and read/write speeds in real time
show_all_disks_desc: Show all logical volumes (C:, D:, ...) or primary only
enable_network_desc: Download/Upload speeds, Local IP and WAN IP
show_sparklines_desc: Show continuous Sparkline trend curves on modules
hotkey_toggle_desc: Global hotkey to toggle panel visibility
hotkey_edge_desc: Instantly moves sidebar between Left and Right
hotkey_screen_desc: Moves sidebar to next connected display
hotkey_reserve_desc: Toggles space reservation for maximized windows
